basis: Defective GM2 degradation causes progressive neurodegeneration; common damaging ocular involvement is not established across B1 presentations.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability are common across partial chromosome 19 duplications; structural organ anomalies vary by duplicated segment.
Macrophage-mediated inflammatory lesions affect muscle and fascia; weakness is very frequent. Fatigue and myalgia do not establish additional organ damage.
Hereditary cutaneous hyperpigmentation defines the disorder; no other organ involvement is established.
PD-1 deficiency causes an autoimmune disease targeting the lungs; immune dysfunction is intrinsic to the disease.
Infarction directly damages the inferior myocardial wall.
Exposure causes corneal and conjunctival injury; this is not intrinsically infectious or autoimmune.
Neoplasm originates in the synovial membrane of joints or tendon sheaths.
Melanoma originates in the iris, an intraocular structure.
Neoplasm involves the biliary tract; intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Glycolytic defect defines hemolytic anemia and myopathy; developmental impairment and ataxia occur in 30-79%. Renal and retinal damage occur in 5-29%.
Primary torsion dystonia is a neurologic movement disorder; abnormal muscle contraction does not establish intrinsic muscle disease.
Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm directly affects marrow and blood-cell production; extramedullary damage is not established as common.
Tunga penetrans infestation directly occupies and inflames the skin.
Carcinoma arises in a parotid salivary-gland pleomorphic adenoma; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction defines disease; chronic middle-ear effusion and conductive hearing dysfunction affect over 30% in primary ciliary dyskinesia.
Skin fragility and congenital pyloric atresia define this subtype; oral blistering and esophageal stenosis reinforce gastrointestinal involvement.
Bile-acid synthesis defects are metabolic disorders, typically with cholestatic liver injury. Neurologic disease is subtype-dependent; malabsorption need not damage bowel.
Neuroendocrine tumor arises in autonomic paraganglia. Catecholamine-related HPO entries conflict with the nonsecreting definition and do not support extra organs.
GATA4-associated atrial septal malformation defines disease; supplied additional defects are also cardiac.
Chondroid hamartoma most commonly denotes a pulmonary hamartoma containing cartilage; pulmonary assignment is uncertain because no site is specified.
Neoplasm directly occupies the myocardium.
Cerebellar degeneration and developmental impairment define disease. Eye-movement abnormalities and weakness are neurologic; flat feet alone do not establish damage.
Meningeal tumor at the tuberculum sellae commonly compresses the optic apparatus, causing visual impairment in roughly 70-90%; skull location adds no skeletal axis.
Skeletal dysplasia defines disease; gingival overgrowth and oral/dental malformations occur in 30-79%. External genital anomalies do not establish endocrine damage.
